'''Slayn & Korpil''' was a manufacturer owned and operated by a [[Verpine/Legends|Verpine]] colony in the [[Roche asteroid field]].

Slayn & Korpil produced the [[V-19 Torrent starfighter/Legends|V-19 Torrent Starfighter]] for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Shortly after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the company, under the supervision of then-Commander [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Gial Ackbar]], contributed the [[A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter/Legends|B-wing starfighter]] to the war efforts of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebellion]]; this ship saw much use in the climactic [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]. Along with the three standard B-wing starfighter models, the company made limited-production B-wings as well.

==History==
Slayn & Korpil was originally a [[Verpine/Legends|Verpine]] Hive colony company based in the [[Roche asteroid field]]. Slayn & Korpil was allied heavily with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], and the company worked with then-commander [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Gial Ackbar]] to develop [[A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter/Legends|B-wing starfighters]] for the Rebel fleet. Slayn & Korpil developed the B-wing, the [[B-wing/E starfighter|B-wing/E]], and the [[A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter/Legends|B-wing/E2]] for the Rebels. The company's other main vehicle used by the New Republic was the [[V-wing airspeeder|V-wing combat speeder]], which was used most notably in the [[Battle of Calamari]].<ref name="EGVV">''[[The Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''</ref>
